# 桌面会话行为：同一组事件由 Swift 与 C++ 正式策略执行；时间单位为秒。
scenario 启动必须等待检测且错误不能触发登录
login_start early 0 1 1 4 30 0
status_start first 1
status_start duplicate 0
login_start early 0 1 1 6 30 0
login_start manual 1 1 1 6 30 0
logout_start during_status 0
status_end first error 1
login_start error_auto 0 1 1 100 30 0
expect error idle 0 0
status_start offline 1
status_end first online 0
status_end offline offline 1
login_start automatic 0 1 1 101 30 1
expect unknown login 0 161
status_start during_login 0
login_start duplicate 1 1 1 101 30 0
logout_start during_login 0
login_end automatic 1 102 1
expect unknown idle 0 162
login_start no_fresh_status 0 1 1 1000 30 0
status_start confirmed 1
status_end confirmed online 1
expect online idle 0 0

scenario 手动失败必须冷却且手动可立即纠错
login_start manual 1 0 1 0 30 1
login_end manual 0 10 1
expect error idle 0 70
status_start offline 1
status_end offline offline 1
login_start immediate_auto 0 1 1 10 30 0
login_start before_boundary 0 1 1 69.99 30 0
login_start correction 1 0 1 20 30 1
login_end correction 1 21 1
expect unknown idle 0 81
status_start confirmed 1
status_end confirmed online 1
expect online idle 0 0

scenario 连续失败退避到五分钟
status_start offline1 1
status_end offline1 offline 1
login_start first 0 1 1 0 30 1
login_end first 0 10 1
expect error idle 0 70
status_start offline2 1
status_end offline2 offline 1
login_start early 0 1 1 69.9 30 0
login_start second 0 1 1 70 30 1
login_end second 0 71 1
expect error idle 0 191
status_start offline3 1
status_end offline3 offline 1
login_start third 0 1 1 191 30 1
login_end third 0 192 1
expect error idle 0 432
status_start offline4 1
status_end offline4 offline 1
login_start fourth 0 1 1 432 30 1
login_end fourth 0 433 1
expect error idle 0 733
status_start offline5 1
status_end offline5 offline 1
login_start fifth 0 1 1 733 30 1
login_end fourth 1 734 0
login_end fifth 0 734 1
expect error idle 0 1034
status_start online 1
status_end online online 1
status_start disconnected 1
status_end disconnected offline 1
login_start reconnect 0 1 1 735 30 1
login_end reconnect 0 736 1
expect error idle 0 796

scenario 注销后在线响应与离线响应都不撤销暂停
status_start online 1
status_end online online 1
logout_start logout 1
expect unknown logout 1 0
status_end online online 0
status_start during_logout 0
logout_start duplicate 0
login_start during_logout 1 1 1 10 30 0
logout_end logout 1 1
expect offline idle 1 0
status_start still_online 1
status_end still_online online 1
expect online idle 1 0
status_start now_offline 1
status_end now_offline offline 1
login_start unintended 0 1 1 10000 30 0
login_start empty 1 1 0 10001 30 0
expect offline idle 1 0
login_start manual 1 1 1 10002 30 1
expect unknown login 0 10062
logout_end logout 1 0
login_end manual 1 10003 1

scenario 注销返回已离线仍暂停
logout_start logout 1
logout_end logout 1 1
status_start offline 1
status_end offline offline 1
login_start unintended 0 1 1 10000 30 0
expect offline idle 1 0

scenario 注销失败仍尊重暂停意图
logout_start logout 1
logout_end logout 0 1
expect unknown idle 1 0
status_start offline 1
status_end offline offline 1
login_start unintended 0 1 1 10000 30 0
logout_start retry 1
logout_end retry 1 1
expect offline idle 1 0

scenario 开关凭据与检测间隔
status_start offline 1
status_end offline offline 1
login_start disabled 0 0 1 0 120 0
login_start empty 0 1 0 0 120 0
login_start manual_empty 1 0 0 0 120 0
expect offline idle 0 0
login_start enabled 0 1 1 0 120 1
login_end enabled 0 1 1
expect error idle 0 121
status_start again 1
status_end again offline 1
login_start retry 0 1 1 121 120 1
login_end retry 0 122 1
expect error idle 0 362

scenario 长检测间隔不会被五分钟上限缩短
login_start manual 1 1 1 0 600 1
login_end manual 0 1 1
expect error idle 0 601
status_start again 1
status_end again offline 1
login_start retry 0 1 1 601 600 1
login_end retry 0 602 1
expect error idle 0 1202

scenario 重复或错误类型回调不能改变进行中的请求
status_start first 1
login_end first 1 0 0
logout_end first 1 0
expect unknown status 0 0
status_end first offline 1
status_end first online 0
expect offline idle 0 0
login_start login 0 1 1 0 30 1
status_end first online 0
login_end first 1 0 0
login_end login 0 1 1
login_end login 1 2 0
expect error idle 0 61
